pageIntro: What we collect, why we collect it, and the choices you have.

sections.heading: Who We Are
paragraphs: Ghostbusters Virginia ("GBVA", "we") is a volunteer-run 501(c)(3) nonprofit. This policy covers ghostbustersva.com, including the members-only area. We collect as little information as we can, and we never sell it.

sections.heading: Information You Send Us
paragraphs: When you use our contact or appearance request forms, we collect what you enter. That can include your name, email address, phone number, organization, and event details. The forms are delivered by email to GBVA volunteers, and we use the information only to reply to you and plan the appearance you asked about.

sections.heading: Information Collected Automatically
paragraphs: Like most websites, our hosting provider keeps standard server logs. These can include your IP address, browser type, and the pages you visited. We use IP addresses briefly to block spam and abuse of our forms.

We do not use advertising or tracking cookies. Some features save settings in your own browser, such as motion preferences, game progress, or member calendar filters. That information never leaves your device.
items: The appearance request form uses Google Maps to look up venue addresses, so Google receives the address text you type.
Our forms may use a spam-protection check that runs in your browser.

sections.heading: Member Sign-In
paragraphs: Members can sign in to the members area with Google. When you sign in, Google shares your name, email address, and profile picture with us. We use your email to confirm you are a current GBVA member. We do not get your Google password or access to your other Google data.
After you sign in, we set one cookie to keep you signed in. It expires on its own, and it ends when you sign out. We store your name so it can be shown next to your event RSVPs.

If the Google account you sign in with isn't on the member list, you can choose "Request access". We then add your name and email address, as Google shares them with us, to GBVA's membership spreadsheet, which GBVA officers use to approve new members. We also email them to the officers, so they can review your request and reply to you. Until you request access or sign in again, a cookie that lasts 30 minutes remembers which Google account is asking. It doesn't give you access to the members area.

sections.heading: Event RSVPs
paragraphs: When you RSVP to an event in the member calendar, your response is saved on the GBVA Events Google Calendar. Other signed-in members and GBVA officers can see your name and your response.

When you RSVP "Yes" or "Maybe", Google emails you an invitation to the event from calendar-automation@ghostbustersva.com, so it can go on your own Google Calendar. When you remove that RSVP, Google emails you a cancellation. "Update My Calendar" in the member calendar's account menu sends invitations again for your "Yes" and "Maybe" RSVPs in the next three months. We don't read or change anything else on your own calendar.

If you change a "Yes" RSVP within two hours of an event's start time, or after the event has started, we keep a record of the change. Only GBVA officers can see these records, which help with event planning. They are kept for up to two years.

sections.heading: Discord
paragraphs: Members can choose to link their Discord account in the member calendar. When you link it, Discord tells us your Discord user ID and username, and we store both. We use them only to add you to the GBVA Discord server's thread for an event when you RSVP "Yes" or "Maybe", on the site or in Google Calendar, including events you RSVP'd to before you linked. If you remove your RSVP and have no "Yes" or "Maybe" left on that event, or on the next six months of a repeating event, we remove you from its thread. Changing your RSVP to "No" leaves you in the thread. To make that work, we keep a list of the events each member RSVPs "Yes" or "Maybe" to, whether or not they've linked Discord. We don't get your Discord password, messages, or server list, and we don't keep any access to your Discord account after linking.

Only you can see which Discord account you linked. Other members don't see your Discord ID or username on the site, though anyone in an event thread can see who has joined it, as on any Discord thread.

When the first member RSVPs "Yes" or "Maybe" to an event, we start a thread for it in the GBVA Discord server. The thread's first message shows the event's title, date, location, a link to the calendar, and how many members have RSVP'd "Yes" and "Maybe". It shows counts only, never names. When an event's title, time, or location changes, or it's cancelled, we post a short notice in its thread. Messages posted in threads are stored by Discord under Discord's own privacy policy.

sections.heading: Maps and Locations
paragraphs: The member calendar uses Google Maps to show where events are. When you view an event's map or turn on the calendar's map, your browser loads it from Google, and Google receives standard technical information from your browser, as it does for any website.

To place events on the map, we send event locations to Google to look up their map coordinates, and keep the results so we don't have to look them up again. These are the event venues that organizers enter, not information about you.

You can choose to add a home location, such as a ZIP code or an address, so the calendar can show events near you, distances, and directions. When you enter one, our server sends it to Google once to find it on the map and returns the result to you. We don't store it or log it. Your home location is saved only in your own browser, so no other member or officer can see it, and you can clear it at any time.
If you use “Use my current location”, your browser asks your permission first. That location stays in your browser and is never sent to us.

sections.heading: How We Share Information
paragraphs: We do not sell, rent, or trade your information. We share it only with the service providers that run this site on our behalf, or when the law requires it.
items: Google: sign-in, calendar, groups, maps, and the membership spreadsheet
Discord: event threads for members who link their Discord account
Resend: delivering form emails and access requests
Upstash: short-term storage for spam protection, RSVP records, and linked Discord accounts

sections.heading: How Long We Keep It
paragraphs: Form messages stay in volunteer inboxes only as long as they are needed. RSVPs stay on the calendar event until you change or remove them, or the event is deleted. Late RSVP change records are deleted after two years. A linked Discord account stays linked until you unlink it, or for two years after you last linked it. The list of events you've RSVP'd "Yes" or "Maybe" to, which we use to add you to threads, is deleted after two years without a new RSVP. An access request stays on the membership spreadsheet as part of GBVA's membership records, and you can ask us to remove it. Server logs are kept for a limited time by our hosting provider.

sections.heading: Your Choices
paragraphs: You are in control of your information:
items: Change or remove any RSVP at any time from the member calendar.
Sign out of the members area at any time.
Clear your saved home location in the member calendar's map at any time, or don't add one at all.
Unlink your Discord account in the member calendar at any time. We delete the stored ID and username right away. You stay in threads you already joined, and can leave them in Discord.
Remove GBVA's sign-in access from your Google Account under Security → Third-party apps & services.
Ask us to see, correct, or delete the information we hold about you through our contact page.

sections.heading: Children
paragraphs: This website is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them. Parents or guardians should submit forms on a child's behalf. If you believe a child has sent us personal information, contact us and we will delete it.

sections.heading: Changes and Contact
paragraphs: We may update this policy as the site changes, and the date at the top shows the latest version. Questions or requests? Reach us through our contact page.
